title: Log sources: event logs, syslog, netflow, packet capture and firewall

videos.script: A security operations centre does not watch people. It watches records. {{records}} Every login, every connection and every file copied leaves a trace somewhere, if somebody arranged for it to be kept. This lesson is about where those traces come from. {{sources}} There are five kinds worth knowing. The machine's own event log. Syslog, which carries it. The firewall's log. Flow records. And the packets themselves. Each one answers a different question, and each one costs a different amount to keep. Then you build the lab this course runs on. {{lab}} Four small machines inside your own computer, with a firewall in the middle. And you log in to one of them once, from outside. {{login}} That one login appears in four places. Putting the four side by side is the first thing an analyst learns to do. {{four}}
